name: Moonraker Dolphin Swims
summary: Snorkel trips from Sorrento Pier in southern Port Phillip Bay to swim with wild bottlenose dolphins, Australian fur seals and weedy sea dragons, with wetsuits, lunch and hot drinks included. There is also a non-swimming wildlife cruise, a full day tour from Melbourne, hot springs packages and private charters. The family business has run since 1990.
standouts: Advanced Eco Certification from Ecotourism Australia
Victorian Tourism Awards Hall of Fame, Ecotourism, 2013

trips.title: 3 hour Dolphin & Seal Swim
trips.summary: A 3 hour snorkel trip on the Silver Fin from Sorrento Pier into southern Port Phillip Bay. Guests swim with Australian fur seals, look for weedy sea dragons in the kelp, and then float in small groups of 10 while wild bottlenose dolphins pass. Lunch, hot drinks and all snorkel gear are included.
highlights: Snorkel with Australian fur seals
Search for weedy sea dragons in the kelp
Float with wild dolphins in groups of 10
Free return within 30 days if no dolphins are found
trips.departsFrom: Moonraker boat shed, end of Sorrento Pier, Esplanade Road, Sorrento VIC 3943
bring: Camera (waterproof if you'd like underwater photos)
trips.requirements: Swimming ability required; guests who cannot swim should not book. Suitable for ages 5+ for swimming. Children must be with an adult.

trips.title: Seal & Sea Dragon Snorkel Tour
trips.summary: A 2 hour snorkel trip with two stops. The first is Chinaman's Hat, a platform where over 100 Australian fur seals rest and young seals swim around the boat. The second is a kelp garden to look for weedy seadragons, followed by a hot drink on the way back to Sorrento Pier.
highlights: Seal snorkel at Chinaman's Hat
Weedy seadragon snorkel in the kelp gardens
Giant smooth rays often seen on the sand
Lunch, snacks and hot and cold drinks included

trips.title: 1.5 Hour Scenic Wildlife Adventure
trips.summary: A 1.5 hour cruise on the Peninsula Pearl for people who want to stay dry. It visits a fur seal colony and an Australasian gannet colony, runs along the Sorrento to Portsea coast, and looks out for resident bottlenose dolphins. The boat is covered and has a glass bottom section.
highlights: Australian fur seal colony
Australasian gannet and seabird colony
Sorrento to Portsea coastline
Glass bottom viewing section

trips.title: Full Day Tour - Ex Melbourne
trips.summary: A full day trip from Melbourne by coach to Sorrento Pier, with 2 hours on the Moonraker to snorkel with fur seals and look for weedy sea dragons. Guests who prefer not to swim can join as sightseers. The return trip stops at Rocky Creek Strawberry Farm, the bathing boxes and Murray's Lookout.

Snorkel with wild fur seals and look for weedy sea dragons
Lunch and snacks on board
Stops at a strawberry farm, the bathing boxes and Murray's Lookout

trips.title: Private Luxury Charter
trips.summary: Private hire of a Moonraker boat with captain and crew for corporate events, birthdays and other groups. The standard charter is 2 hours from Sorrento to Portsea for up to 60 guests, any day of the year, at a time you choose. Catering and drinks packages can be added; BYO alcohol is not allowed.

The group picks two snorkel sites from seals, dolphins, the marine park and weedy sea dragons, and chooses a morning, midday or afternoon start. Gear, guides, hot showers and change rooms are included.

trips.title: School Tours
trips.summary: Curriculum-linked marine programs for primary, secondary and tertiary groups, led by qualified guides, instructors and biologists. Options include boat snorkels with seals, dolphins and sea dragons, beach snorkels, wildlife sightseeing cruises and on-land sessions on ocean litter and rockpools. Programs run year round by enquiry.

checkNotes: moonrakercharters.com.au redirects (301) to www.moonrakerdolphinswims.com.au, so all pages were read on that domain. Public tour prices appear only as 'From' prices on the homepage, not on the tour pages; child age bands are not given. Departure times for Sorrento tours are not on the site. The SILVERFIN promo is stated on the site as '20%' off signature tours (homepage says 'Signature tours', specials page says 'all signature tours'); kept out of copy as a percentage. Dolphin Guarantee wording conflicts between tour page (30 days) and Terms (3 months). Terms list minimum numbers (swim tour 10, sightsee tour 15) and a cancellation fee stated as a percentage. Vessel names vary on the site ('Silver Fin', 'Sliver Fin', 'SILVERFIN'). The site claims 'Australia's most awarded dolphin swim company' and '100% carbon offset'; not repeated. Peninsula Hot Springs photos were not used.
